assets.prompt: Use case: infographic-diagram. Create a polished Chinese enterprise knowledge product diagram, landscape 3:2, high resolution crisp simplified Chinese, white background navy type with refined teal/indigo accents, consistent executive editorial style, generous whitespace, aligned restrained cards, simple line icons. Title exact「业务知识结构如何搭建」. Subtitle exact「从业务问题出发，验证后发布，持续维护」. Top half is a clear six-step LEFT-TO-RIGHT process numbered 01–06 with arrows and TWO SHORT TEXT LINES per step, no dense paragraphs: 01「确定领域」/「范围与责任人」; 02「收集业务问题」/「预期答案与边界」; 03「定义知识结构」/「概念、对象与关系」; 04「映射资料与证据」/「条件、来源与缺口」; 05「双应用验证」/「共用知识能否使用」; 06「审核发布」/「版本与变更责任」. Center below process a large worked example section headed「同一业务事项，多种使用方式」. Draw a small meaningful knowledge graph centered on a node「访客接待事项」. Connect left node「适用人员」 with edge label「适用于」, top-left「所需材料」 with label「需要」, top-right「办理步骤」 with label「包含」, right「例外情形」 with label「存在例外」, bottom「依据制度」 with label「依据」. Add modest small note near graph「关系和条件均需依据」. To the right of this example place two application cards connected from graph center with clear fan-out arrows:「员工助手」/「说明如何办理」 and「流程 Agent」/「读取前提与步骤」. Lower band contains three equal, distinct compact panels:「目录」/「资料归档与责任」;「标签」/「多维筛选与查找」;「知识结构」/「业务含义与关联」. These three panels are separate supporting functions, not sequential processing arrows. A feedback arrow from step05 back to step03 labeled「不通过则修订」, noncrossing, unmistakable direction. Footer exact「业务负责人确认定义；AI 提出候选；复用不扩大权限。」. Do not invent extra steps or contents. Avoid circuit boards, 3D isometric complexity, filler words, decorative people and tiny text. Make all Chinese exact and legible.

assets.prompt: Use case: infographic-diagram. Upper half a very clear six-step LEFT-TO-RIGHT pipeline with 01–06: 01「提出要求」/「问题、依据与负责人」; 02「定义范围」/「目录、类型与适用条件」; 03「写明判断」/「检查项、证据与处置」; 04「样本试跑」/「正常、异常、边界样本」; 05「审核启用」/「权限、版本与生效时间」; 06「任务执行」/「固定版本、逐份回执」.
